title: Critical Sobolev thresholds for openness and discreteness of Monge-Ampere gradient mappings
summary: Let $Ω\subset\R^n$ be a domain and let $u\in W^{2,n}_{\loc}(Ω)$ satisfy \[ \det D^2u\geqδ>0\qquad\text{a.e. in }Ω. \] Guerra and Tione asked whether the gradient mapping $Du$ must be open and discrete. We give a negative answer in every dimension $n\geq4$, in a form that isolates the sharp regularity mechanism. First, a local Pogorelov model is chosen to solve the exact equation $\det D^2u=1$ a.e.
